add_product.title: Add Amazon product
add_product.description: Enter the details of the product to monitor.

data_description.asin: 10-character ASIN code (e.g. B09FKN79QR). Find it in the product URL after /dp/.
data_description.name: Name shown in Home Assistant
data_description.marketplace: Amazon website to track the price on (e.g. amazon.com, amazon.de)
data_description.alert_threshold: Price below which you want to trigger automations

import_wishlist.title: Import Amazon wishlist
import_wishlist.description: Enter the URL of a public Amazon wishlist. A sensor will be created for each product found.

data.alert_threshold: Price alert threshold for all products (optional)

data_description.url: Full URL of the public wishlist. The wishlist must be set to Public on Amazon.
data_description.alert_threshold: Threshold applied to all imported products. Can be changed per-product later.

error.invalid_asin: Invalid ASIN. Must be exactly 10 alphanumeric characters (A-Z, 0-9).
error.already_configured: This ASIN is already being monitored.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Amazon. Check your network connection.
error.invalid_wishlist_url: Invalid wishlist URL. Make sure you copy the full URL of a public Amazon wishlist.
error.wishlist_not_found: Wishlist not found or set to Private on Amazon.
error.wishlist_empty: No products found in the wishlist. It may be empty or set to Private.

abort.wishlist_imported: Import complete: {added} products added out of {total} found.

init.title: Edit product
init.description: Update the name or price threshold. The ASIN cannot be changed.

data_description.name: Name shown in Home Assistant
data_description.alert_threshold: Leave empty to remove the threshold
